statement: Implement `hinge(y_true, scores)`, the mean hinge loss. Each label is −1 or +1 and each score is a real decision value. The per-example loss is max(0, 1 − y * score). Average over the batch.

approaches.name: Margin loss
approaches.explanation: The hinge is the convex surrogate used by linear SVMs.

editorial: Hinge loss max(0, 1 − y s) is zero once the signed score clears a margin of 1, and linear beyond that. Support vector machines minimize this loss plus an L2 penalty on the weights, which is why only points inside or on the margin become support vectors. Labels must be −1 and +1, not 0 and 1. If your dataset uses 0/1, map 0 to −1 before calling this function. The subgradient with respect to the score is −y when the margin is violated and 0 when it is satisfied.
